verbatim: The composition of a system is the set of its components; the environment, the set of items with which it is connected; and the structure, the relations among its components as well as among these and the environment.

The composition of a system is the set of its components; the environment, the set of items with which it is connected; and the structure, the relations among its components as well as among these and the environment.
Finally the structure of a thing will be defined as the set of all the relations among the thing's components as well as among these and the things in the thing's environment.
